design: per-token symmetric INT8 K+V (dynamic row scales, uniform kernels, no calibration)

diagnostic.finding: uniform per-token misses on random queries (4-7%%, K dominates via softmax amplification; finer groups don't help); peaked (realistic) regime ~5e-3 -> GO, e2e arbitrates
diagnostic.isolation: K-only 4.25e-02, V-only 7.4e-03, K-per-channel 4.25e-02 (axes don't matter, granularity doesn't matter)

kernels.KvAppendI8: 1 WI/head, row max-abs + round-half-away quant (matches Quantize kernel bit-exact)
kernels.AttnCoreI8: AttnCore clone, int8 rows decoded as convert*row-scale (exact)

loop.wiring: decode_l0 AINFER_KV8=1: int8 heaps (halves 64K KV 4->2 GiB) + fp32 scale rows, 16 layers rewired
loop.quality_gate: 53/53 top-1 vs BF16 references across all 6 corpus prompts (p0-p5 9/9 vs BF16 loop; p1 8/8 vs full-BF16 truth; short [369,279,248046] identical incl. top-5 order)
loop.verdict: PASS — INT8 KV preserves greedy trajectories exactly on the measured corpus

postmortem: first integration diverged everywhere: KvAppendI8 launched with KVW=1024 (copied BF16 pattern) but kernel is WI-per-head -> heap overflow 256x trashing neighbor slots. Caught by top-5 triage (20%% global logit shrink + reshuffle = systematic, not flip noise). Fixed launch=4 + in-kernel bounds guard (wrong counts now fail safe).
